title: Kling 3.0 Turbo
description: Kuaishou Kling 3.0 Turbo — fast text-to-video and image-to-video (start frame only) with native audio always included. 720p or 1080p, priced per resolution (see `resolution_pricing` in GET /v1/models). Any duration from 3 to 15 seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Ignored when a start image already sets the frame.

image.description: Optional start frame for image-to-video. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-video.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Pricing varies by resolution — see `resolution_pricing` in GET /v1/models.
